# Hurtle

Hurtle is an original endless descent arcade game that runs in a browser. You
steer a ball down a narrowing track, avoiding blocks and clearing gaps, and the
run ends when you hit something or fall off. It is free, has no accounts, no ads
and no third-party requests.

Ten settings are exposed to the player and change the generated track and the
view: steepness, path width, obstacles, jumps, floor tilt, speed, camera angle,
camera height, and two colour controls (neon and accent).

Every player gets the same track on the same day. The seed is derived from the
UTC date, so scores on a given day are directly comparable without any server.
A random track is also available at any time.
